description: The pie chart on the left illustrates the relative share of the most frequent languages in the OpenAssistant Conversations dataset, with each language represented by a colored slice and its corresponding percentage labeled. English dominates the dataset with a 42.8% share, represented by a large dark blue slice. Spanish follows with a 31.4% share, shown in a medium blue slice. The remaining languages are represented by smaller slices: Russian at 5.7% (light blue), German at 3.6% (very light blue), French at 2.9% (even lighter blue), Chinese at 2.5% (lightest blue), Thai at 1.9% (very light blue), Portuguese (Brazil) at 1.7% (light blue), and Catalan at 1.6% (very light blue). A final slice labeled "Other" accounts for 5.8% of the total, depicted in a light gray color. The slices are arranged in descending order of size, starting with English and proceeding clockwise, and the chart includes a legend and percentage labels for each category.
